## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

source                                    results  share of the score
<a name="lmarena-dataset"></a><a href="https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset/blob/9041150e8a502da9f0e75c89824d34ad7dba7072/webdev/latest-00000-of-00001.parquet">LMArena leaderboard dataset</a>                     3   56% ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇

## How to run it

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~240 GB, NVIDIA only, from [huggingface.co/nvidia](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-BF16/blob/1f8953f7f0935358e3605150d22bc15df062061c/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   vllm serve nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-BF16 \
     --served-model-name nemotron-3.5-super-vl \
     --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
     --trust-remote-code \
     --gpu-memory-utilization=0.85 \
     --allowed-local-media-path=/ \
     --max-num-seqs=32 \
     --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"video": 1, "image": 1}' \
     --video-pruning-rate 0.5 \
     --media-io-kwargs '{"video": {"fps": 2, "num_frames": 256}}' \
     --enable-auto-tool-choice \
     --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder \
     --reasoning-parser nemotron_v3 \
     --speculative_config.method mtp \
     --speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens 3
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/nvidia](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-BF16)
